channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Guatemalan lawmaker and three police officers killed in armed attack
item.description: It happened in a region of the country known to have drug trafficking activity.

item.title: Five killed and at least 10 injured in Krakow shooting
item.description: Five people have been killed and at least 10 injured in a shooting near the main market square in Krakow, Poland.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC says building underground sites for weapons production, storage
item.description: IRGC says underground military complexes allow missile production to continue even under heavy bombardment.

item.title: At least five people killed in shooting in Poland’s Krakow
item.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk says police are investigating after 'tragic shooting' in second-largest city.

item.title: ‘They started bombing us with drones’: Russian attacks unnerve Zaporizhzhia
item.description: A region once offering refuge becomes increasingly dangerous, as 50 people are killed in a single attack.

item.title: Qeshm island and Hormuz hit, as mediators try to prevent US-Iran escalation
item.description: US strikes have continued on Iran after more ships in the Strait of Hormuz were attacked.

item.title: Dozens killed as humanitarian crisis mounts in Yemen: What next for war?
item.description: Government forces reclaim key territories in Taiz and Lahij but face setbacks under Houthi resistance in certain areas.

item.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
item.description: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

item.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
item.description: One child and one young adult were killed in the crash, local authorities say, with more injured.

item.title: US midterm results spark fears in Israel over future of two countries' ties
item.description: Staunch US support of Israel has been raised as one of the reasons why Republicans performed so badly.
